source_row.rationale: Penetrating trauma can directly inoculate organisms and lead to osteomyelitis. Focal bone pain with local warmth or swelling and systemic symptoms such as fever warrants evaluation for bone infection.
source_row.source_detail: History and Physical; contiguous/direct-inoculation osteomyelitis after trauma; last update May 31, 2023; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.stem: A client develops focal bone pain, warmth, swelling, and fever several weeks after a deep puncture wound to the foot. Which complication should the nurse suspect?
